title: All Hallows at Moochie
desc: All Hallows is back for it's 11th anniversary, and is the perfect place to get immersed in autumn and Halloween, doing whatever floats your ghost at this time of year. So be strange, but don't be a stranger... and remember, if the wind calls at night, you must not listen. The wind is lonely and always looking for company. Halloween has arrived.

title: Salem 1692: The Halloween Experience
desc: Salem 1692 is a Halloween destination inspired by the history and dark folklore surrounding the Salem witch trials. Visitors can explore the village, historic homes, woodland paths, fairgrounds, and interactive haunted scenes, with live entertainment taking place throughout the season. The region is completely free to visit, with two optional ticketed experiences available.

title: SHADOWFELL V
desc: The mists have lifted once again on SHADOWFELL! Now in its 5th year, creators Ty Tenk and Truck Meredith continue to update, enhance, and add to this ever-evolving world of beauty, horror, and magic. Explore 4 immersive regions by Elven Boat or The Elven Flyer, or venture into Caverns, Forbidden Forests, Swamps, and Ancient Elven Ruins—or attend live music at the Shadowfell Pavilion. The journey continues…

title: Old Town at Adagio Gardens
desc: It is an Old Town: a place of tree-lined cobblestone streets, brownstones, and small shops. Built in a time of elegance, Old Town is beautiful in its bright autumn colors. Browse the shops, wander through the farmer's market, play in the carnival, or find a cozy spot to relax and take in the season. When the music starts, join in at the Old Town stage for live karaoke and community gatherings. Come explore and enjoy autumn in Old Town at Adagio Gardens.

title: Halloween Haunted Neighborhood
desc: Linden Lab's Millbank region has undergone a spooky overhaul, with numerous Linden Homes getting a haunted horror theme. Grab a red balloon, explore the haunted houses, and enjoy the eerie sights! Take a step inside the homes while you’re at it: there are such sights to show you.

title: LeLoo's World Amber Moon Trail
desc: LeLoo's World Amber Moon Trail leads visitors through a softly haunted world where the full moon tints the land with a warm, eerie glow. Guests can explore on foot or ride along in a guided cart tour.  Feel the need to fly? Grab a broom from the rezzer and make your way to the sky! Turn on sounds and use Shared environment for best viewing. Everyone is welcome to this PG event!

title: Shadows in the Mist: Inspire Space Park
desc: Experience a hauntingly celestial Halloween transformation at Inspire Space Park. Wander beneath alien moons, through glowing portals and drifting cosmic fog, where twisted landscapes, strange creatures and forgotten secrets wait in the darkness. Step beyond the ordinary and into Inspire Space Park, where cosmic wonder, fantasy, mystery, and exploration collide.

title: Haunted Dreams
desc: Haunted Dreams blends autumn romance with Halloween scares. Visitors can dance in fall meadows, explore a misty cemetery, brave a derelict house and an asylum, then make their way to a sinister carnival filled with creepy sights and rides.

title: The Bradbury Project
desc: The Bradbury Project is produced by Seanchai Library and invites guests to walk in the footsteps of Tom Skelton and his friends as they explore Ray Bradbury's 1970s fantasy novel "The Halloween Tree." Over 30 hours of events: music, dancing, stories, and quests. Open October 3 through November 3, 2026.

title: Grand Harbor Isle
desc: Experience fall at Grand Harbor Isle! Explore beautiful rentals, stroll through cozy autumn décor, and enjoy the colors and charm of the season. When night falls, gather your courage and venture down the spooky haunted trail. Come visit Grand Harbor and celebrate the magic, mystery, and excitement of fall!

title: The Nature Collective
desc: Autumn has arrived at The Nature Collective. Wander golden woodland trails, discover wildlife, explore interactive exhibits, forage for mushrooms, and keep your eyes open. You never know what you might find hidden among the trees. Come get lost in nature!

title: Pour Up Winery & Vineyard
desc: Established in 2021, Pour Up Winery & Vineyard is a scenic, romantic destination perfect for dates, with wine tasting, paint and sip, pottery, fishing, ziplining, horseback riding, live music events,  and vineyard views. Visitors can relax, explore, and enjoy photo opportunities throughout the grounds.

title: Ethereal City
desc: Established in 2008, Ethereal City is an urban-themed, photogenic destination. Autumn settles over Ethereal City with crimson canopies, leaf-strewn stone plazas, lamplit balustrades, a quiet vendor's cart, and a cozy horse-drawn carriage through quiet streets. Wander slowly; it's a memory you can step into.

title: Halloween Haunted Tour
desc: The bone-chilling Halloween Haunted Tour by Linden Lab is back again! Hop in a coffin and enjoy the wild ride through the twisted mind of madness.

title: Bayou Chat Noir Halloween
desc: The witches are back in the Bayou, and this time, they’ve come to stay. They’ve settled into the old house, unpacked their potions, hung up their hats, and made themselves quite at home. Come wander through their wonderfully spooky world and see what they’ve been up to. Visitors are always welcome. Just remember... not every guest leaves exactly as they arrived.

title: MIRROMERE
desc: Rediscover MIRROMERE, a cherished jewel of Calas Galadhon Park, beautifully renewed. Wander beneath majestic Redwoods into flower-filled meadows, explore the Coast Trail on horseback, or find a secluded haven for reflection and meditation. Discover romantic hideaways, dance beneath the trees, or simply hold someone close. Let nature embrace you and MIRROMERE weave its own special magic.

title: Lune by Cica Ghost
desc: ''There is something haunting in the light of the moon.'' - Joseph Conrad

title: Harvest Hollow by Dream Seeker Estates
desc: An abandoned farm where the crops still grow, and nobody knows what happened to the people who once lived here. Explore old farms, barns, and cornfields, and enjoy the spooky attractions.

title: Ravenbrook
desc: A charming little town comes alive for Halloween with autumn streets, pumpkins, and festive decorations, but a murder has left the community full of secrets. Explore the town, follow clues, and solve the mystery while enjoying the haunted forest, corn maze, pumpkin carving, haunted boat ride, cemetery, shops, and spooky hidden corners throughout town. Who done it? The clues are waiting.

title: October
desc: October at alphatribe island is a sprawling village where houses are people! This is quite a crowded little place with lots of inhabitants, busy fetching water from two wells, admiring fountains, hanging around, gossiping, and generally enjoying the lovely Autumn afternoon. A granddad is telling some tall tales to his granddaughters - but they are sort of hidden, so you will have to look for them. A young man is having a sad episode by the sea - thankfully, he has a cat for company! A bunch of mutinous scarecrows is having a confab in a field. A flotilla of toy ships is chugging by. And the villagers are conscious of keeping the place neat and tidy - so you will encounter some very respectable folk wielding brooms against the onslaught of fallen leaves.

title: Blue Finch's 5th Annual Haven Hollows
desc: Ready for a spooky adventure? Come explore a place where there’s something fun hiding around every corner! Hop aboard an adorable Spooky Owl Bear and tour the destination with a friend, or grab a Haunted Bike and cruise through the eerie scenery. Feeling adventurous? Gather your crew and set sail on an Erie Boat Ride! Don’t forget to visit the mysterious Witch’s House, discover cozy cafés, and find the perfect spot to relax and hang out. Come explore, take a ride, make some memories—and stay awhile if you dare!

title: Nightshade Academy
desc: Step beyond the gates of Nightshade Academy at Power Up Park, where magic, mystery, and imagination come alive. Explore an enchanted school nestled among ancient castle walls, mystical woodlands, faerie spaces, wandering spirits, and curious ravens. Get a tarot reading, gather for a séance, try the spirit board, wander enchanted forests, encounter woodland and mystical creatures, and uncover hidden magical spaces throughout the grounds. Explore witchcraft, faerie lore, enchanted arts, and more at this destination, which is the official fundraising arm of the Charge Syndrome Foundation.
